Name: Spouses Cook For You
Author: Giantkiller311
Description:
[b]Spouses Cook For You[/b] adds a daily cooking routine to your married life in Stardew Valley, written to feel natural and lore friendly, like it was always part of the game. Once you trigger your spouse's cutscene, they will cook you a fresh meal every single morning before you head out to the farm. Every spouse has their own cutscene, their own dialogue written to match their personality, and their own weekly menu.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unique cutscene for each spouse with custom written dialogue[/*]
[*]7 different meals per spouse, one for each day of the week[/*]
[*]Custom marriage dialogue referencing the cooking routine[/*]
[*]Covers Emily, Haley, Penny, Abigail, Leah, Maru, Harvey, Elliott, Alex, Sam, Shane, Sebastian and now RSV Spouses.[/*]
[/list]Want to know what each spouse can give you? Expand the section below.

[spoiler]Here is the full meal list for each spouse. Most meals are chosen to match their personality and loved gifts, like Emily making burgers for you. If a meal choice seems confusing, it is usually based on that spouse’s loved gifts, like Maru with Miner’s Treat.
[b]Emily[/b]
• Survival Burgers, Pancakes, Complete Breakfast, Fruit Salad, Pumpkin Pie, Super Meal and Omelet.
[b]Haley[/b]
• Omelet, Pancakes, Hashbrowns, Triple Shot Espresso, Complete Breakfast, Fried Egg and Blueberry Tart.
[b]Penny[/b]
• Farmer's Lunch, Roots Platter, Autumn's Bounty, Red Plate, Rice Pudding, Pancakes and Spaghetti.
[b]Abigail[/b]
• Spicy Eel, Blackberry Cobbler, Pumpkin Pie, Survival Burger, Pepper Poppers, Strange Bun and Lucky Lunch.
[b]Leah[/b]
• Salad, Tom Kha Soup, Vegetable Medley, Blueberry Tart, Dish O' The Sea, Roasted Hazelnuts and Stir Fry.
[b]Maru[/b]
• Cheese Cauliflower, Complete Breakfast, Miner's Treat, Roots Platter, Survival Burgers, Tom Kha Soup and Omelet.
[b]Harvey[/b]
• Super Meal, Salad, Bean Hotpot, Vegetable Medley, Fruit Salad, Farmer's Lunch and Hashbrowns.
[b]Elliott[/b]
• Crab Cakes, Tom Kha Soup, Lobster Bisque, Shrimp Cocktail, Dish O' The Sea and Seafoam Pudding.
• One meal is currently missing and will be added in the next update.
[b]Sam[/b]
• Pizza, Pancakes, Omelet, Complete Breakfast, Super Meal, Survival Burger and Farmer's Lunch.
[b]Alex[/b]
• Complete Breakfast, Salmon Dinner, Omelet, Pancakes, Survival Burger, Farmer's Lunch and Hashbrowns.
[b]Shane[/b]
• Pizza, Pepper Poppers, Hashbrowns, Omelet, Pancakes, Strange Bun and Survival Burger.
[b]Sebastian[/b]
• Pumpkin Soup, Omelet, Pizza, Super Meal, Rice Pudding, Survival Burger and Spaghetti.[/spoiler]
[b]Compatibility:[/b] PC & Android | Stardew Valley 1.6 | Requires SMAPI + Content Patcher

Enjoying the mod? Leave an endorsement and check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42768]Emily Extra Dialogue[/url], which adds new dialogue lines and cutscenes for Emily written to feel like they were always part of the game.
